# Orion Soft Limited

> Orion Soft Limited is a Nigerian software company (CAC RC 9535128, Ajah, Lagos) that builds business management software for African organisations and custom websites, web apps and mobile apps. Its flagship product, CareCore, is a hospital management system running in Nigerian hospitals.

- Website: https://www.orionsoftlimited.com
- Email: orionsoftlimited@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +234 816 957 7059
- Location: Urban Prime 2, Abraham Adesanya, Ajah, Lagos, Nigeria (serves clients across Nigeria, Africa and internationally)
- Book a demo: https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/consultation
- Contact: https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/contact

## Products

- [CareCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/carecore): Hospital management system (HMS) for hospitals, clinics, pharmacies and labs in Nigeria. 25+ modules: electronic health records, outpatient (OPD), inpatient and wards (IPD), pharmacy, laboratory (LIS), radiology, billing and NHIS/HMO claims, appointments, staff, and executive analytics. Live in Nigerian hospitals.
- [SchoolCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/schoolcore): School management software for primary and secondary schools and higher institutions: admissions, attendance, results in WAEC/NECO formats, fees, timetables, CBT exams, library, staff payroll and a parent portal.
- [ComplianceCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/compliancecore): Compliance and risk management for banks, health and public organisations: policies, risk register, audits, regulatory calendar (CBN, NDPA/NDPR, CAC, NAFDAC), incidents and training records.
- [InventoryCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/inventorycore): Inventory and supply chain software: multi-warehouse stock, purchase orders, reorder alerts, suppliers, barcode/QR scanning, batch and expiry tracking.
- [FinanceCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/financecore): Accounting software built for Nigeria: invoicing, payables/receivables, bank reconciliation, payroll with PAYE, pension and NHF, VAT and WHT, financial statements and budgets.
- [HRCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/hrcore): HR software: employee records, recruitment, onboarding, leave, attendance, payroll integration, performance reviews and training.
- [ChurchCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/churchcore): Church management software: members, attendance, cell groups and units, tithes and giving, events, SMS/email, volunteers and reports.
- [FleetCore](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/fleetcore): Fleet management: vehicles, drivers, trips, maintenance, fuel, documents and GPS.

## Services

- Custom software, web applications, dashboards and portals
- Business and e-commerce websites
- Mobile apps (Android and iOS)
- Implementation, data migration, training and support

## For international clients

- [Work with us from abroad](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/international): Orion Soft builds web apps, mobile apps, SaaS, healthcare and education software for companies and organisations worldwide. West Africa Time (UTC+1, overlapping UK and EU working hours), English-first, fixed-price quotes in USD, GBP or EUR, dedicated developers or teams, NDA on request, and support after launch.

## Free tools

- [Nigeria PAYE & Take-Home Pay Calculator 2026](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/paye-calculator): Free salary and income tax calculator under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (in force from 1 January 2026), with rent relief, pension, NHF and NHIS, a band-by-band breakdown, employer cost, and a comparison with the old Personal Income Tax Act. Can be embedded on other websites.
- [Nigeria PAYE API](https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/developers): Free JSON API, no key needed: GET https://www.orionsoftlimited.com/api/public/paye?salary=500000 returns PAYE, deductions, take-home pay, tax bands, employer cost and the old-law comparison. Parameters: salary (required), period, rent, pension, nhf, nhis, pensionable, basic.
- [nigeria-paye on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nigeria-paye) / [GitHub](https://github.com/orionsoftlimited/nigeria-paye): Open-source (MIT) JavaScript/TypeScript library by Orion Soft with the same Nigeria Tax Act 2025 PAYE engine. `npm install nigeria-paye`.
